postconditions.description: The output permutation A has length N.

postconditions.expression: all(x in range(1, N+1) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output permutation A is an integer from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(output.count(x) == 1 for x in range(1, N+1))
postconditions.description: Each integer from 1 to N appears exactly once in the output permutation A.

postconditions.expression: all(median(output[:i]) != median(output[:i+1]) for i in range(N-1))
postconditions.description: For every 1 ≤ i < N, the median of the prefix P_i is not equal to the median of the prefix P_{i+1}.
